page.overview:
Who is Petrie?

Petrie is an enemy of Fu Manchu who fought a long war against him alongside Shang-Chi.

Petrie and Sir Denis Nayland Smith fought for forty years against Fu Manchu but were ageing. Then Fu Manchu ordered his son Shang-Chi, who believed his father was a noble man dedicated to world peace, to kill Petrie. Shang-Chi obeyed the order though he only killed a replicant. This led Shang-Chi to encounter Nayland Smith and learn the truth about his father. Petrie was found alive and together with Shang-Chi, Nayland Smith, Black Jack Tarr an ex soldier and Clive Reston, a smooth talker, the war continued.
